name: 1v1 Matchmaking & Rematch End-to-End (two browsers)
note: This gate ended in `.catch(console.error)`. A timeout printed a stack trace, exited 0, and the pipeline stayed green — proven by pointing it at a selector that does not exist. The catch now exits 1, and this mutation is what keeps that true.

mutations.name: rematch stops starting a fresh puzzle for both players
mutations.why: Two people accept a rematch and get different boards, or no board. The gate has to reach the end and fail rather than time out quietly.

mutations.name: the game stops feeding the replay recorder
mutations.why: Replays keep only the values sendProgress reports: no notes, no undo, nothing the player did between reports.

mutations.name: undo is recorded as a move
mutations.why: The replay shows the player typing where they took a move back, and its undo count is always 0.
mutations.find: markCause('u'); // the replay records these cells as undone, not typed (I-1)
